options.text: Air in the room is a natural resource because nature provides it and it helps meet needs.
A plastic chair is a natural resource because it is useful in the classroom.
Only rocks underground count as natural resources; air does not.
Anything shiny on the desk is a natural resource.

stem:
Salim sorts classroom objects. He asks whether each is a natural resource.

Which claim uses the correct test?

teacher.key_rationale: A natural resource is provided by nature and helps meet needs. Air fits. A plastic chair is made by people. Usefulness or shine alone is not the test.
